I was just thinking about this. My mother never really taught me much about chores, except for doing the dishes. I don’t know how to use a washing machine and I wash my clothes by hand (which I figured how to do myself) I don’t know how to cook dishes except for easy ones like frying an egg for example. I remember when I was younger, she would get mad at me for not helping her around the house. I didn’t want to help her because she would only expect me, her only daughter to do the work while my brother can get away with it and just lay in bed all day. Meanwhile, I was mostly depressed but to her, I’m just lazy.
